chapter: Touring in the bus years and Jim Crow in the South
title: Harold Iller, the white replacement for Luther West
summary: Fields hires white Harold Iller from Minneapolis after Luther West is inducted, at the Happy Hour, from where he called Love.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x:
That was in the forties. Early forties. That was after we had been to New York and everything because we had good booking then, but I was getting enough money that I would travel on the train sometimes. It was World War II, the gas was rationed, so I know it was in the forties, and so I would travel on the train; and while we're talking about incidents, I want to tell you about another one.

This was also in Florida, and I had a white boy, you know, Eli--
Yes, but I had Harold Iller out of Minneapolis.
No, it started with an I. I believe it's Iller or something like that. Anyway, Harold Iller, he took Luther West's place; have you heard of the Happy Hour? I went into the Happy Hour in Minneapolis--
We played with Nat Towles, just ahead of you.
Yeah. Well I went in there for two weeks and stayed four, and so--
You called me to join you at the Happy Hour.
Yeah, that's when Spurgeons was inducted. So I couldn't get anybody else and
